simulate.requirements: Python with numpy and scipy (.venv-rigid-elastic: numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.15.3); CPU only

render.requirements: Blender 4.3.2 (tools/blender-4.3.2-linux-x64 in the repository root); ffmpeg for the video

build_pcve.requirements: Python with numpy (.venv-rigid-elastic/bin/python or the genesis venv); reads the caches

implementation_policy: CPU implicit solve (numpy/scipy L-BFGS-B, 1/1920 s steps, cached at 96 Hz) of a 6x6x8-cell tetrahedral finite-strain viscoelastic foam block coupled to a guided platen with a shallow cup, a 32 mm steel ball that rolls down an analytic ramp and is then caught by penalty cup contacts with Coulomb friction and rolling resistance, and a passive hinged flag lifted by the platen edge (physics/physics.py, geometry in physics/rig.py, baseline, the four whole-clip edits and the timed edit in physics/config.py). A timed edit runs in the same solve as the source parameters and switches the ball mass at its edit step. The four whole-clip edits replay their accepted caches (assets scenes/silicone_block_chain/accepted_solves/physics), baked into the accepted packed scenes (accepted_solves/packed/<case>.blend); the source and the timed edit replay a re-solve kept with the suite case (native_metadata), baked into the workshop template by appearance/bake_native.py. appearance/realism.py renders the current look and checks every frame against the cache before rendering; appearance/scene.py is the bake and the delivered look (tools/worker.py). Video frame f is native sample 4(f-1); 1280x720, 24 fps, 96 frames. tools/export_ground_truth.py writes pcve_ground_truth/1 ground truth from the solves, tools/publish_suite.py assembles and swaps in a suite. Material, friction and contact values are nominal, not calibrated.
